meta.name: add-mattermost
meta.description: Add a self-hosted or cloud Mattermost bot channel through the Chat SDK bridge, reusing a local server when available and offering an evaluation server when none exists.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给 Mattermost 添加机器人频道,自动复用本地或评估服务器
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果团队用 Mattermost 需要快速接入机器人频道
copy.tagline_en: Add a Mattermost bot channel, auto-reusing local or evaluation server
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team uses Mattermost and needs to quickly add a bot channel

howto.what: Claude 会带你走完把 Mattermost 机器人频道接入 NanoClaw 的流程:先探测本地是否已有可用服务器,没有就问你确认后装一个本地评测服务器,再配置站点地址、机器人令牌、卡片回调和你自己的私信。
howto.when: 当你要把 Mattermost 的私信、频道或互动审批卡片接入 NanoClaw 时,Claude 会接管这套添加流程。

say.text: 帮我添加 Mattermost 频道,先看看本地有没有现成的服务器。
say.note: Claude 先探测本地服务器,再让你选用哪个。

say.text: 给我装一个本地评测用的 Mattermost 服务器。
say.note: 它会先说明将创建的容器和端口,等你确认。

say.text: 把机器人接入我自己的 Mattermost 服务器,我来给地址。
say.note: 接着会依次配置 SiteURL 和机器人令牌。

howto.what_en: Claude walks through adding a Mattermost bot channel to NanoClaw: it first looks for a healthy local server, offers a local evaluation server if none exists, then sets up the site URL, bot token, card callback, and your DM.
howto.when_en: Use when you want Mattermost DMs, channels, or interactive approval cards brought into NanoClaw; Claude then takes over the add-channel flow.

say_en.text: Add a Mattermost channel and check for an existing local server first.
say_en.note: Claude probes local servers, then asks which to use.

say_en.text: Set up a local evaluation Mattermost server for me.
say_en.note: It lists the containers and ports it will create first.

say_en.text: Connect the bot to my own Mattermost server; I'll give the URL.
say_en.note: Then it configures SiteURL and the bot token.
